articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: UK’s largest banks complete world’s first interbank transactions using tokenized deposits
articles.snippet: Barclays, NatWest, and HSBC and others used tokenized deposits for remortgages and a marketplace-payment test, taking bank-issued digital cash beyond a single institution.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

articles.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
articles.snippet: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

articles.title: A week of AI coding cut a quantum-safe bitcoin transaction estimate from $320 to $66
articles.snippet: StarkWare, which conducted the research, says contest participants using AI tools made the computation about five times faster, though the $66 figure has not yet been demonstrated in another transaction mined on Bitcoin.
